title: Valorization of areca nut husk and water hyacinth fibers into biodegradable plates for sustainable packaging
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00319A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bedanta Rajbongshi, Akuleti Saikumar, Laxmikant S. Badwaik
The development of biodegradable plates using cellulose fibers of areca nut husk and water hyacinth helps to create eco-friendly alternative to conventional plastic plates and mitigate environmental concerns associated with non-degradable packaging.
